description: A Makefile target that needs a SITE variable on the make command line.

trap.note: make render must be given SITE=<name>; there is no default and no site list target.

prompts.text: Generate the config for the `alpha` site with the project's Makefile. It should end up in site-out/alpha.conf. Just run the tool; don't read its source or docs first.
Remember, `make render` has to be given `SITE=<name>` every time; it has no default. Generate the config for the `beta` site with the project's Makefile. It should end up in site-out/beta.conf.
Generate the config for the `gamma` site with the project's Makefile. It should end up in site-out/gamma.conf.
